run_benchmark_evaluation: run a benchmark evaluation of a forward-only agent against a Habitat task config YAML file
create_custom_agent: create a custom Habitat agent by subclassing habitat.Agent and implementing reset and act methods
evaluate_agent_episodes: evaluate an agent over a specified number of episodes using habitat.Benchmark and collect metrics
use_habitat_sim_actions: use HabitatSimActions enum values like MOVE_FORWARD to define agent movement actions in the act method
parse_task_config_cli: parse a task config YAML path via argparse to configure a Habitat benchmark evaluation run
